text: Being a Binance angel gave me the opportunity to grow my network, support the local team and increase the awareness of Binance in my local country. I joined Binance angel program because I wanted to go more deeper inside crypto, to be more connected to the leader and the biggest platform that was Binance, and to be able to give my feedback to Binance about the product, about some element and to have more info, to know more how an exchange was working on the backstage. It's very easy to apply for the angel program, by the way, so you can just follow the link on the website and once that is done, there will be a screening process. You might be invited to the angel bootcamp and you will also meet me there, of course.
